title: A machine learning-assisted hypoxia-associated prognostic model reveals PFKP-mediated glycolytic regulation in uveal melanoma
summary: In a TCGA uveal-melanoma cohort (n=80), machine-learning approaches nominated prognostic candidates; ENO3/PFKP were evaluated in an independent cohort. PFKP perturbation experiments reported changes in proliferation, glycolysis and xenograft growth. Author affiliations were not available in the reviewed publisher passages; organization left empty.
